authority: Trusted runner selects known runtime grants; script cannot supply raw allow flags.
enforces: Scoped runtime operations; host-chat transport scope, not application authorization.
observes: Native access/check events where available; supervisor can map some uncaught permission failures.
limitation: HOL-008 lacks a trusted subprocess observation; collection complete is not instrumentation completeness. Runtime restriction is not an independent OS kernel.
failure: Absent/misconfigured Deno expands in-container authority; Docker/gateway may still constrain configured resources/effects. This removal is a design counterfactual, not an ablation experiment.

risk: Host exposure, process/filesystem state sharing and uncontrolled resources.
authority: Trusted engine/runner own image, mounts, user, network, cgroups and privileges.
observes: Runtime/control inspection and lifecycle outcomes; not a detection classifier.
limitation: Authoritative final control claims remain configuration-verified; bounded historical probes are supplementary. runc shares a kernel; no exploit campaign.
failure: Current Docker provider fails rather than silently executing on host/mock if supervisor/engine unavailable; a hypothetical Deno-only redesign lacks the independent container boundary.

risk: Direct workload interaction with host-kernel interfaces.
authority: Trusted runtime selection on the native experimental engine; not client-selected.
enforces: Additional application-kernel boundary by design; no measured escape effectiveness.
observes: Trusted daemon/container identity, compatibility and duration; not a maliciousness detector.
limitation: 9/10 workloads; host-chat DNS incompatible, WSL2/systrap/one release. Escape prevention untested.
failure: Without runsc, normal runc path works but additional boundary is absent; no quantified security loss measured.

risk: Confusing network reachability with authority over the active host.
authority: Execution-scoped session, action allowlist, TTL and per-execution budget; separate admin listener.
enforces: chat.broadcast authorization/message/budget before authenticated internal enqueue.
observes: Requested/allowed/denied/queued call events with trusted correlation.
limitation: Only one meaningful sandbox capability; trusted services/secrets and Paper remain assumptions; confirmation is not exactly-once proof.
failure: Intended host effect becomes unavailable on request-path failure. Bypassing the gateway would remove this boundary; bypass was rejected in tested routes, not experimentally enabled.

risk: Infinite work, excessive output/concurrency and ambiguous cleanup.
authority: Trusted runner tracks active jobs and owns wall/capture/cleanup deadlines and fixed resource policy.
enforces: Local capacity2, 429 overflow, timeout/output bounds and admission block on uncertain cleanup by design.
limitation: CPU/PID/privilege controls not all attack-tested; local process scope, residual host/control-plane DoS and operator recovery.
failure: Unconfirmed cleanup deliberately reduces availability by blocking admission. Shared blocked-flag unit assertion is not the local counter in cleanup.json; no new live cleanup-failure injection.

risk: Loss of execution identity, host provenance and reconstructable project evidence.
authority: Trusted persistent storage and queue-side origin/correlation mapping.
enforces: Application data/queue constraints, not runtime permissions or security-event detection.
observes: Persists supplied trusted observations/results and reconstructs timeline.
limitation: Durable within demonstrated healthy DB writes, not tamper-proof/independent forensics; crash/outage finalization or HA not established.
failure: API persistence/finalization/queueing may fail; retrospective evidence can be lost even if containment runs. This outage was not experimentally tested.

risk: Operationally fragmented timing/correlation across orchestration evidence.
authority: No execution/capability authority; API emits reconstructed OTLP spans/events to collector.
observes: execution/sandbox.run, advisory and host events, counters and trace IDs.
limitation: Debug output non-durable; no full independently instrumented Paper trace, no guaranteed complete telemetry or IDS.
failure: Observed collector outage degraded export, not restrictions/host authorization/DB writes. No zero-delay, replay or whole-system resilience claim.

risk: Inconsistent human interpretation of predefined trusted evidence indicators.
authority: Read evidence and produce LOW/REVIEW/HIGH metadata; cannot grant/deny execution authority.
enforces: No permission, resource or capability controls.
observes: Interprets recorded fields through transparent fixed rules; not hidden behavior.
limitation: 24/25 controlled label agreement; known development cases and related holdouts, HOL-008 absence of trusted observations.
failure: Assessment failed/unavailable/null classification may coexist with completed execution; evidence review remains necessary.

risk: Potentially inflexible interpretation of structured execution evidence; alternative advisory assessment.
authority: External pinned Choice model/policy classifies sanitized evidence; no sandbox/host authority.
enforces: No permission, resource or capability controls.
observes: Second interpretation with model confidence, not additional runtime sensors.
limitation: 16/25 modal reference agreement, no Jev-only modal gain, two variable cases; short window/one model/policy/provider and no free-text rationale.
failure: Provider/account/analysis failure affects advisory availability; deterministic option/containment remain separate. No automatic consensus benefit was evaluated.
